_comment: Advisor kinds. Each gives its modifier times the advisor's skill (1 to 3). One advisor of each category (admin, diplomatic, military) may serve at a time; salary rises with skill.

types.name: Treasurer
types.description: Keeps the accounts and squeezes the tax.

types.name: Master of Scribes
types.description: Heads the schools and the archives.

types.name: Steward of Works
types.description: Sees the crown's buildings up cheaply.

types.name: Chancellor
types.description: Settles the quarrels of the great.

types.name: Chief Priest
types.description: The gods' favour keeps the people quiet.

types.name: Chief Envoy
types.description: Known and liked in every court.

types.name: Spymaster
types.description: Forges claims and finds what is hidden.

types.name: Master of Trade
types.description: Knows every caravan master and shipowner.

types.name: Marriage Broker
types.description: Arranges the matches that bind kings.

types.name: Master of Levies
types.description: Calls up more of the people.
